title: Portable grants form architecture: initial proof package
summary: A compact index of reproducible technical evidence for portable declarative forms. It separates observed compatibility from semantic, accessibility, policy, and release acceptance.

claims.title: SF-424 has a bounded real-runtime comparison and compatibility receipt
claims.statement: A generic lower-environment path creates existing and portable applications, exercises render, conditional interaction, validation, save and reload, and print, and emits a pinned side-by-side receipt and recording.
limitations: The generated receipt and video are build outputs, not versioned source files.
The merged fork evidence is not a production registration or approval.

claims.title: SF-424 Short passes the same six generic Stage A browser probes
claims.statement: The bounded receipt covers preview registration, adapter API preflight, real Apply rendering, deterministic edit and save/reload, automated accessibility scanning, and print rendering without a form-specific adapter branch.
reproduce: Generate a bounded plan with PORTABLE_BROWSER_FORM_IDS=sf424-short and run the @portable-catalog Chrome test documented in api/src/form_schema/form_spec/README.md
limitations: The receipt is generated and ignored by Git; rerun the pinned branch to reproduce it.
Zero automated Axe violations is not a human accessibility approval.

claims.title: SF-424A passes the same six probes with its declarative budget tables and calculations
claims.statement: The bounded plan observes six specialized budget interaction surfaces, 13 editable schema bindings, and 35 calculation declarations; the real application path preserves 116 editable controls through save and reload and reaches locked print rendering.
reproduce: Generate a bounded plan with PORTABLE_BROWSER_FORM_IDS=sf424a and run the @portable-catalog Chrome test documented in api/src/form_schema/form_spec/README.md
limitations: The receipt proves observed runtime compatibility, not human acceptance of source semantics or production release readiness.

claims.title: R&R SF-424 executes generic lifecycle rules, validates XML, and passes the bounded runtime probes
claims.statement: The portable declaration supplies date ordering and XML structure; the generic consumer executes lifecycle validation, validates representative submit-populated XML against the exact RR_SF424 5.0 XSD, and preserves 89 controls through the six generic browser probes.

evidence.label: Representative R&R SF-424 XML validated against official XSD
Declarative date-order validation through the lifecycle
R&R SF-424 bounded browser compatibility receipt

reproduce: In grants-form-spec at 563e7d8b5a38c7b5d66723bfbc1607caeeff4aad, run npm ci && npm run preflight
In simpler-grants-gov at 5ef1589b971cb685780f902b782c3cf6ef65e953, run the focused R&R SF-424 lifecycle, rule, and XML tests listed in PR 28

limitations: The XML mapping remains source-bound and unreviewed for human semantic acceptance.
The automated browser and Axe receipt is not human accessibility, policy, or production-registration approval.

claims.title: Five R&R Budget-family profiles reuse one declarative structure, calculation graph, and XML mapping
claims.statement: The family publishes five duration and subaward profiles without a form-family compiler or adapter branch; all 56 DAT-defined calculations are declared, representative maximal XML for each profile validates against its pinned official XSD, and the condition inventory records 64 conditioned occurrences: 50 represented by existing declarations, 10 compiled through one generic cross-section condition contract, and four explicitly source-bound and uncompiled.

evidence.label: Exact R&R Budget DAT condition inventory
Shared declarative XML target across five profiles
Generic Simpler XML execution and exact-XSD validation

reproduce: In grants-form-spec at 563e7d8b5a38c7b5d66723bfbc1607caeeff4aad, run npm ci && npm run preflight
Inspect tests/test_budget_profiles.py, analysis/rr-budget-dat-conditions.v1.json, and the five emitted form target profiles produced by npm run emit
limitations: The condition inventory and family evidence remain explicitly unreviewed for semantic acceptance.
Four numeric-string attachment/positive-total occurrences remain source-bound and uncompiled; semantic acceptance, human accessibility, policy, and production-registration gates also remain open.

claims.title: Reviewed pairwise similarity is currently unavailable; exploratory similarity remains separate
claims.statement: The analysis export reports zero accepted form-question occurrence mappings. It therefore leaves every reviewed pairwise count and similarity value blank while publishing implementation-derived exploratory similarity in a separate artifact.

evidence.label: Analysis export contract and review boundary

reproduce: Clone grants-form-spec with full Git history and check out 563e7d8b5a38c7b5d66723bfbc1607caeeff4aad
Run npm ci && npm run emit && npm run project-evidence
limitations: Reviewed semantic similarity is unavailable because the current evidence has zero accepted occurrence mappings; blank reviewed values must not be read as zero similarity.
Exploratory similarity uses implementation-derived canonical identities and is not published semantic coverage.
The analysis files are generated build outputs and are not committed to the runtime source tree.

releaseBoundaries: Technical compatibility evidence is not human semantic acceptance.
Automated accessibility checks are not human accessibility approval.
Existing runtime behavior is a compatibility oracle, not semantic authority.
No evidence in this package constitutes policy approval or production registration.
Proposed or unreviewed mappings do not contribute to published coverage metrics.
